items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: You know he later played with Artie Shaw?

ctx.x: We got to play across from Cass Long and that's where we got to know Peewee Hunt -- he was playing there. They didn't have but two trombones when I first played across from Cass Long and Billy Rausch. Billy Rausch was a beautiful trombone player, a beautiful trombone player.
And when I first played across from Isham Jones, Jack Janney was playing trombone with Isham. You know he later played with Artie Shaw?
